in_marathi.name: Antara
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Inner or Intermediate
in_marathi.long_meaning: Antara हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Antara means inner, intermediate or between. In Hindu mythology, Antara is the name of a river goddess and a star in the constellation of Vishapam. This name symbolizes the bridge between the physical and spiritual worlds, and the inner journey towards enlightenment.
